hero.label: Why OmniAssess
hero.works: Works on your phone and on a laptop.

slides.text: Get familiar with real exam patterns, section timings and rules, so you walk into your actual exam with confidence.
slides.alt: A student taking a timed mock exam on a laptop, with a stopwatch and a list of exam sections where finished sections are locked.

slides.text: A solution for every question, where you went wrong, and a clear plan to fix it.
slides.alt: A student thinking beside a detailed analysis card with a donut chart, correct and wrong rows, and a magnifying glass.

slides.text: Every attempt is compared with your last, so you can see the marks you gained.
slides.alt: A student celebrating in front of a rising score chart, a progress ring and a trophy.
